verdict.rationale: Devin CLI lets users leave the Adaptive model router and pick a specific model with /model, so there is some control over which model the agent runs on. Nothing in the evidence shows bringing your own API key or plugging in a self-chosen or self-hosted LLM, and that is the core of the story. Missing for 10: BYOK / own API-key configuration, support for custom or self-hosted LLM endpoints, org-level model policy for cloud Devin sessions, a documented list of selectable models, and independent corroboration.
